description: Change the seller's buyer support agent. Only the fields you pass change. `rules` REPLACES the whole list, so read it with get_support_agent first and send every rule you want kept (with its id) plus any new ones. A rule is one plain-words instruction, e.g. "Leave anything about refunds for us". Rules apply from the next buyer message. Try a change with try_support_agent before saving it.

mode.description: off = does nothing. prepare = writes each reply and leaves it for the seller to send. auto = sends replies to buyers by itself.

policy.description: Shop notes the agent may quote: dispatch days, returns, postage. Replaces the current notes.

id.description: The id of an existing rule. Omit for a new rule.

text.description: The rule, in plain words. At most 600 characters.

name: update_support_agent
